privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.lede: What this website collects, described exactly as the code does it. The site is open source, so everything described here can be checked in <source>axross/btnopen.com</source>.
privacy.lede-bases: This website runs analytics that rests on your permission, and collects error information whether or not you gave it.
privacy.analytics-item-page: The URL of the page you viewed
privacy.analytics-item-links: Clicks on the links to GitHub, LinkedIn, and X
privacy.analytics-item-params: URL query parameters used to manage blog posts (never used in ordinary reading)
privacy.analytics-body: <mixpanel>Mixpanel</mixpanel> does the collecting. Unrelated clicks and scrolling are not observed, and sessions are not recorded. Your browser's Do Not Track setting is honoured.
privacy.analytics-gate: Until you allow it, the Mixpanel code itself is never loaded, and not a single HTTP request is sent.
privacy.diagnostics-heading: Running whether or not you allow it
privacy.diagnostics-body: <sentry>Sentry</sentry> collects and records the following when an error occurs, which is what the site is improved from.
privacy.diagnostics-item-identity: Your IP address and user information
privacy.diagnostics-excluded: Cookies and request and response bodies are not recorded.
privacy.diagnostics-replay: Only in a session where an error occurred, how the screen changed is recorded, so the bug can be investigated and reproduced. In ordinary use, with no error, no such recording is made at all — whichever way you answered.
privacy.comments-body: <clerk>Clerk</clerk> brokers your GitHub sign-in. Four things are recorded alongside the comment itself: your Clerk user ID, display name, GitHub username, and avatar image URL. No email address is stored.
privacy.cookies-body: As its own cookies, this website stores the display language you chose, your analytics permission, and a CSRF token for posting a comment.
privacy.control-body: The switch below turns your analytics permission on and off at any time. Collection starts, and stops, the moment you flip it.
privacy.control-undecided: Not answered yet. Nothing is being collected.
